question.text: The number of distinct real roots of the equation $|x||x+2|-5|x+1|-1=0$ is_______

solution.text: Case-1 $\begin{aligned} & x \geq 0 \\ & x^2+2 x-5 x-5-1=0 \\ & x^2-3 x-6=0 \\ & x=\frac{3 \pm \sqrt{9+24}}{2}=\frac{3 \pm \sqrt{33}}{2} \end{aligned}$ One positive root Case-2 $\begin{aligned} & -1 \leq x < 0 \\ & -x^2-2 x-5 x-5-1=0 \\ & x^2+7 x+6=0 \\ & (x+6)(x+1)=0 \\ & x=-1 \end{aligned}$ one root in range Case-3 $\begin{aligned} & -2 \leq x < -1 \\ & x^2-2 x+5 x+5-1=0 \\ & x^2-3 x-4=0 \\ & (x-4)(x+1)=0 \end{aligned}$ No root in range Case-4 $\begin{aligned} & x < -2 \\ & x^2+7 x+4=0 \\ & x=\frac{-7 \pm \sqrt{49-16}}{2}=\frac{7 \pm \sqrt{33}}{2} \end{aligned}$ one root in range Total number of distinct roots are 3
